Who can use the library?: All registered students, academic and non-academic staff can use the library. External researchers and visitors may also use the library but require special approval and may need to pay a fee.
Can outsiders or non-students access the: Yes, external researchers and members of the public may access the library, but they require special approval and may be required to pay a fee before entry is granted.
What do I need to enter the library?: You need a valid University ID card or proof of registration (such as a school charges receipt) to enter the library.
What are the library's opening hours?: The library is open Monday to Friday from 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM. Saturday hours vary by branch — please check with your specific branch. The library is closed on Sundays and public holidays.
Is the library open on weekends?: Saturday opening hours vary by branch. The library is closed on Sundays and all public holidays.
How do I borrow a book?: To borrow a book, bring it to the circulation desk along with your University ID card and your borrower's ticket. Library staff will process the loan for you.
How many books can I borrow at once?: Undergraduates may borrow up to 2 books for 2 weeks. Postgraduates may borrow up to 4 books for 1 month. Staff may borrow up to 5 books for 1 month.
How long can I keep a borrowed book?: Undergraduates can keep books for 2 weeks. Postgraduates and staff can keep books for up to 1 month.
How do I return a borrowed book?: Bring the book(s) to the circulation desk and library staff will process the return for you.
Can I renew a book I have borrowed?: Yes, you can renew a book at the circulation desk, provided it has not been requested by another user.
What happens if I return a book late?: Late returns attract fines and may result in the suspension of your borrowing privileges. Please return or renew books before the due date to avoid penalties.
How much is the fine for returning a boo: Fines are charged for overdue books and the amount depends on how long the book is overdue. Persistent late returns may lead to suspension of your library borrowing privileges. Please ask at the circulation desk for the current fine rates.
Is there Wi-Fi in the library?: Yes. The UNIJOS-Hotspot Wi-Fi network is available for students and staff within the library premises.
Does the library have electronic resourc: Yes. The library provides access to electronic resources including e-books and academic journals through the university library website.
How do I access the library's online res: You can access e-books, journals, and other electronic resources through the university library website. Ask a librarian if you need help getting started.
Can I borrow past student projects or di: No. Past student projects, dissertations, and theses are available for reading within the library only and cannot be taken out.
Does the library have photocopying or pr: Yes, photocopying services are available in the library, subject to copyright regulations.
What are the rules inside the library?: Library users are expected to maintain silence at all times, avoid eating or drinking inside the library, keep mobile phones on silent mode, and not reserve seats for others.
Am I allowed to eat or drink in the libr: No. Eating and drinking are not permitted inside the library.
Can I use my phone in the library?: Yes, but your phone must be kept on silent mode at all times. Conversations and loud ringtones are not allowed in order to maintain a quiet study environment.
How do I find a book in the library?: You can search for books using the library catalogue. Note the call number of the book you need and use it to locate the book on the shelf. You can also ask a librarian for assistance.
What is a call number and how do I use i: A call number is a unique code assigned to each book that determines its location on the shelf. Once you find the call number from the catalogue, use it to navigate to the correct section and shelf.
Who do I contact if I need help in the l: You can approach any library staff member or visit the circulation desk for assistance. Librarians are available to help you find resources, use the catalogue, and answer any questions.
Can I reserve a book that is currently o: You may request a book that is currently borrowed by another user. Ask at the circulation desk and library staff will assist you.
Does the library have a catalogue I can: Yes. The library has a catalogue you can use to search for available books and resources. You can search by title, author, or subject.
Is there a quiet reading area in the lib: Yes. The entire library is expected to be a quiet environment. Please maintain silence and follow library rules while using the reading areas.
What should I do if I lost a library boo: Report the lost book to the circulation desk as soon as possible. You may be required to replace the book or pay the cost of replacement.
Can I bring my personal belongings into: Personal items such as bags may be subject to checking at the entrance. Valuables are your personal responsibility, and the library may not be liable for any lost items.
How do I register as a library user?: Library registration is typically done with your student or staff ID. Visit the library or the circulation desk to complete registration and obtain your borrower's ticket.
